chapter_title: Concerning the Five Forms that exist in the Rulers of Darkness.
chapter_note: The chapter is dominated by a systematic correspondential body→world mapping (five forms from the five worlds of darkness) followed by additional triads of ruler-qualities. The final two paragraphs pivot into direct second-person exhortation (“my beloved ones…”)—an application/pastoral add-on consistent with the chapter’s strong second-half drift signal. The opening contains a hagiographic seating/speaking frame that must be stripped to recover the core teaching introduction.

paragraphs.core_text:
⟨p.77⟩
Consider the ruler, the leader of all the powers of darkness. Now, five forms exist in his body, corresponding to (the archetype) of the five creations that exist in the five worlds of darkness.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed the dialogue/hagiographic frame formula: “Once again, the apostle is sitting among the congregation. He says to his disciples:” (Layer-2 compilation frame; ‘apostle’ attribution).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core teaching begins with impersonal structural exposition (five forms ↔ five creations ↔ five worlds). The paragraph’s initial ‘apostle among the congregation’ is a late framing device, hence MIXED with frame stripped.

paragraphs.core_text: Indeed, his head is lion-faced, which came about from the world of fire. His wings and his shoulders are eagle-faced, after the likeness of the children of the wind. His hands and his feet are daemons, after the likeness of the children of the world of smoke. His belly is dragon-faced, after the likeness of the world of darkness. His tail is the form of the fish, which belongs to the world of the children of water. These five shapes are in him, and they came from the five creations of the five worlds of darkness.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Pure cosmos→cosmos correspondential mapping (body parts/animal forms ↔ the five dark worlds and their ‘children’), in a systematic expository voice.

paragraphs.core_text:
⟨p.78⟩
Should he wish, he shall walk on his two feet [ ... ] world of smoke. Also, when he wants, he shall [ ... ] four [ ... ] on his hands and feet [ ... ] like the children of fire. Should he wish, he shall rise up on his wings, like the children of the wind. Also, should he wish, he shall plunge down to the waters like the children of water. Again, should he wish, he shall crawl on his belly like the children of darkness. These five shapes are in him.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continues the internal cosmological description of the ruler’s five-form mobility, each motion keyed to a dark-world type; no audience-address or institutional application.

paragraphs.core_text: Also, there are three other (qualities) in him.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Numbered/iterative structural marker typical of the core’s schematic presentation (introducing a triad of qualities).
Fragmentary, but preserves the schematic ‘first/second/third’ enumeration style of the core teaching.

paragraphs.core_text: The second: Shall a [ ... ] his magic arts. When he wishes, he shall make an invocation over himself, and hide from his powers. When he wants, he shall show himself to them and strike a death-blow by his magic arts. Any word he might utter at that moment, he shall [wreak magic] by it.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Describes an intrinsic faculty/operation of the ruler within the dark cosmos (concealment, appearance, lethal speech/arts), not a warning about contemporary practitioners.

paragraphs.core_text: The third: His body is strong, a[1]] [ ... ] nails and claws of his powers are not able to penetrate it. No iron nor copper body will equal him [ ... ]; they will not be able to destroy him, because he was formed and fashioned from the hard-hearted counsel of Matter, the mother of demons and fiends.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmic-material constitution and hierarchy language (‘formed and fashioned… Matter’) in impersonal explanatory mode; still fully internal to the system.

paragraphs.core_text: Again, there are three others in him.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Another schematic triad-introduction, indicating continued core enumeration.

paragraphs.core_text: When he wants, his fire shall {blaze), and his entire body be made like the [ ... of] fire.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Internal elemental transformation ability attributed to the ruler; correspondential/physical-cosmic description without exhortation.

paragraphs.core_text: Also, when he wishes, he shall send out frost, and his entire body freezes like a [ ... of] snow.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Pairs with the previous line as another intrinsic transformation (fire/frost), continuing the core’s descriptive list.

paragraphs.core_text: The third: Whenever his powers are stood before him, he shall look at them and understand; for [whatever ex]ists in their heart he shall understand, what is in their heart and their face so long as they are stood before him. When they retreat before him and distance themselves from him, he shall not understand what is in their heart. There is no life in him whatsoever, but his 'life' is the bile of anger that is apparent on his face and in his fear. Shall a [ ... ] destruction that is establ[ished be]fore him.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Faculty-description (bounded perception/knowledge; ‘life’ as anger-bile) presented as cosmic mechanics, not moral instruction—typical core voice despite lacunae.

Direct second-person exhortation with application voice (“Behold… my beloved ones… Hold yourselves secure…”) applying the ruler-description to audience conduct; likely later pastoral/application graft.
Continues exhortative second-person register (zeal/perfection, ‘inherit life for ever and ever’) rather than cosmological mapping/mechanics; fits end-of-chapter editorial drift.
